cards.why_this_role: At a company under 50 people, the CTO or technical founder likely owns the decision on how Voxel's computer vision models get served in live industrial deployments, and the site shows no sign of a dedicated ML infrastructure hire.
cards.cares_about: Keeping a small technical team focused on the product rather than on running model serving themselves.
cards.opening_angle: Voxel runs live computer vision on existing camera feeds in logistics and manufacturing, and Baseten turns ML models into production APIs, so you can run them as production APIs without building serving yourselves.
